| Generate JS/TS app | `pnpm nx g @nx/next:app name` |
| Generate JS/TS lib | `pnpm nx g @nx/js:lib name` |
| Init Python project | `cd apps/name && uv init` |

content.user_title: Manage Nx Monorepos with AI Guidance
content.value_statement: Large Nx workspaces are hard to navigate, test, and keep fast as teams add projects. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical Nx command guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains Nx project graph commands and dependency analysis workflows.
Guides affected build, test, and lint commands with base and head options.
Provides app and library generation patterns for Next.js, React, JavaScript, and Node.
Documents Nx cache configuration, Nx Cloud setup, and stable cache inputs.
Shows how to add Python uv workspace projects with Nx task definitions.
Outlines CI, troubleshooting, and quick reference commands for common Nx tasks.
limitations: It provides command guidance and examples, not executable automation scripts.
It assumes Nx CLI and the chosen package manager are installed in the workspace.
Python support uses manual project configuration with uv workspace guidance.
It does not replace human approval for security, production, or breaking changes.

use_cases.title: Plan Affected Builds
use_cases.description: Identify projects touched by a change and choose focused build, test, and lint commands.

use_cases.title: Add Workspace Projects
use_cases.description: Generate or plan new apps and libraries while keeping the Nx graph and cache behavior clear.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Monorepo Ownership
use_cases.description: Use ownership, routing, and review guidance when teams share large repository areas.

prompt_templates.title: List Workspace Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to list Nx projects, view the project graph, and inspect dependencies for one project.

prompt_templates.title: Add a New App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step plan to add a Next.js app named dashboard under apps/dashboard, then verify it in Nx.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize CI Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an affected-only CI plan for this Nx workspace with lint, build, test, cache setup, and failure triage.

prompt_templates.title: Review Monorepo Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this monorepo for project boundaries, cache inputs, Python uv integration, dependency graph risks, and ownership gaps.

output_examples.input: Add a Python service to an Nx workspace.
output: A setup plan that creates the service directory and initializes uv.
Workspace membership changes to make the service visible from the root.
Nx task guidance for build, test, and lint commands.
Verification steps using project listing and graph inspection.

output_examples.input: Find why builds are slow in my monorepo.
output: A cache investigation plan covering target defaults and stable inputs.
Affected command checks before running full workspace tasks.
Nx Cloud connection checks and local reset guidance.

output_examples.input: Prepare CI for pull requests in an Nx workspace.
output: A pull request workflow outline focused on affected lint, build, and test tasks.
Guidance to fetch enough history for base comparisons.
Package manager setup notes for repeatable installs.
Review checkpoints for security and breaking changes.

best_practices: Use affected commands with explicit base and head references before broad workspace runs.
Preview generators before writing files, then verify the project graph after generation.
Keep cache inputs stable and document Python uv workspace membership at the repository root.
anti_patterns: Running full workspace builds for small changes without checking affected projects first.
Adding packages or Nx plugins without confirming workspace package manager and version expectations.
Letting AI approve security-critical, production, or breaking changes without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill run Nx commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for commands that a user or agent can choose to run.

faq.question: Which package managers does it mention?
faq.answer: It includes examples for Nx CLI, pnpm, npx, and uv workspaces for Python projects.

faq.question: Can it help with Nx Cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains connection commands, remote cache verification, and cache input planning.

faq.question: Can it create Python projects in Nx?
faq.answer: It guides uv initialization, workspace membership, and manual Nx task configuration for Python projects.

faq.question: Is it useful for CI pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes affected-only CI guidance and GitHub Actions setup concepts.

faq.question: Does it handle team governance?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference material covers CODEOWNERS, task routing, RFCs, and human review gates.
